description: Source code for credential management services including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations, utilizing database repositories and utility functions.

methods.name: createCredential
methods.description: Creates a new credential entity, saves it to the database, and handles errors.

methods.name: deleteCredentials
methods.description: Deletes a credential by ID within a workspace, throws error if not found.

methods.name: getAllCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a workspace, including shared credentials, with optional filtering by credential name.

methods.name: getCredentialById
methods.description: Fetches a credential by ID, decrypts data, and indicates shared status.

methods.name: updateCredential
methods.description: Updates an existing credential with new data, merging decrypted data with request body.
